source.title: Duskwood Mission XV: Defeat Amokarok
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Rotting Orchard. Defeat the worgen leader Amokarok there and return to me.
source.objective: Defeat Amokarok in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion at a campsite near the barn in the Rotting Orchard and return to Field Captain Palandar.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
